ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.subtitle: Reading report photos and voice notes, and the assistant for reps
ai.intro: Before you turn it on, know what is sent and what is kept:
points: Report photos, voice recordings and reps' questions are sent to outside AI services so they can be read and answered.
During the trial these services are free, and the companies that run them may use what is sent to improve their products.
Report photos may show customer names, and those names are sent with the photo.
The app never sends PINs or phone numbers itself. Tell reps not to type or say them in a question.
No number read from a photo or voice note is saved until the rep reviews it and presses confirm.
Each rep reads a notice and agrees to it before their first use, and you can turn the service off at any time.
